# Agent instructions

## Repository overview

- This is a minimal repository containing only [README.md](../README.md).
- The README currently serves as a greeting and project introduction.
- There is no application source, package manifest, build system, linter, or test suite.

## Working with the repository

- Make small, relevant changes; do not introduce frameworks, tooling, or dependencies unless explicitly requested.
- Preserve the README's simple tone and Markdown formatting.
- Use Markdown headings and short paragraphs unless a change specifically requires another structure.
- Keep repository-relative paths in Markdown links and use `/` separators.
- Do not infer or document build, run, test, or deployment commands that are not present in the repository.
- When documentation is changed, verify that links and headings are valid and the Markdown renders clearly.

## Validation

- Before finishing, review the diff for unintended files or changes.
- There are no project build or test commands in this repository.
- For Markdown-only changes, use any targeted preview or link check available and inspect `git diff` for correctness.
